experiment_data.hypothesis: D&R epoch-matched with independent LR schedule (total_steps=2533, not 6103). Eliminates LR schedule confound: previous epoch-matched used 6103-step schedule but stopped at 2533, leaving LR at ~62% peak. New schedule completes full decay over 2533 steps. If PPL is similar to previous epoch-matched (~17.65), the LR confound was negligible.
